title: Saturn is lighter than water.
description:
Saturn is lighter than water. Not lighter in total. Lighter on average, per cubic centimetre, than the water in your kitchen tap. It is the only planet in the Solar System where that is true.

Saturn's mass compared with Earth's. Almost entirely hydrogen and helium, the two lightest elements there are, stretched across a planet nine times Earth's width.

Only as a density comparison. There is no ocean anywhere near big enough, and if there were, the pressure at the bottom would stop the water from staying liquid. The density is real. The bathtub is not.

Ninety-five Earths' worth of mass, and still less dense than your bathwater.
